inventory.name: Sdelete deployed via GPO and run recursively

properties.description: The alert rule was disabled due to too many consecutive failures. Reason: This rule has been experiencing permanent errors and has been disabled. These errors indicate configuration or query issues that require manual intervention. Please review and fix the rule, then re-enable it. For troubleshooting guidance, see: https://aka.ms/AnalyticsAutoDisabledRules This query looks for the Sdelete process being run recursively after being deployed to a host via GPO. Attackers could use this technique to deploy Sdelete to multiple host and delete data on them.
properties.displayName: Sdelete deployed via GPO and run recursively
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where Process =~ "svchost.exe"
  | where CommandLine has "-k GPSvcGroup" or CommandLine has "-s gpsvc"
  | extend timekey = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
  | project timekey, NewProcessId, Computer
  | join kind=inner (SecurityEvent
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where Process =~ "sdelete.exe" or CommandLine has "sdelete"
  | where ParentProcessName endswith "svchost.exe"
  | where CommandLine has_all ("-s", "-r")
  | extend newProcess = Process
  | extend timekey = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
  ) on $left.NewProcessId == $right.ProcessId, timekey, Computer
  | extend HostName = tostring(split(Computer, ".")[0]), DomainIndex = toint(indexof(Computer, '.'))
  | extend HostNameDomain = iff(DomainIndex != -1, substring(Computer, DomainIndex + 1), Computer)
  | extend AccountName = tostring(split(TargetAccount, @'\')[1]), AccountNTDomain = tostring(split(TargetAccount, @'\')[0])
